reviews.text: ما غير شيء كبير ببشرتي و لاحظت انه لو حطيته ينشف وجهي شوي لاكنه يسوي اشراقه خفيفه للوجه هل اشتريه مره ثانيه ؟ لا السراحه ما يستاهل على سعره
reviews.zh: 對我皮膚冇咩大影響。我發現搽上面嗰陣面會稍微乾咗啲，但會令面有少少輕微嘅光亮。我會唔會再買？唔會，以呢個價錢嚟講，舒緩效果唔值。

reviews.text: Ces masques sont très rafraichissant, idéal avant de maquiller ou quand ma peau est légèrement inflammée. Je recommande
reviews.zh: 呢啲面膜好清涼，化妝前或者皮膚有少少發炎嗰陣用好啱。我推薦。

reviews.text: The SKINFOOD Potato Madecassoside Daily Mask is pure magic. I bought it for my mom, and she loves it—her skin looks brighter, and she follows up with her favorite moisturizer to seize the day
reviews.zh: SKINFOOD Potato Madecassoside Daily Mask 簡直係神奇。我買俾我媽媽，佢好鍾意——佢嘅皮膚睇落更明亮，用完之後再搽佢最愛嘅保濕霜，好好把握每一日。

reviews.text: I hv used the pads of it and it was the best of all variety, j hv tried it's apricot, carrot also the rice type but this is the best I hv used so far... and it's my favorite also due to it's brightening effect... it sure do works
reviews.zh: 我用過佢哋嘅化妝棉，係所有款式中最好嘅。我都試過佢嘅杏桃、胡蘿蔔同埋米嘅，但係呢款係我到目前為止用過最好嘅……佢亦都係我最鍾意嘅，因為佢嘅提亮效果……確實有效。

reviews.text: J'ai acheté ces masques après avoir testé les disques pads de la même gamme. Le format est super économique (30 masques) et l'actif "Madecassocide" qui de trouve dedans est une vraie pépite ! Si vous avez des rougeurs difficiles à apaiser ou comme moi de l'acné hormonale, c'est vraiment magique, je recommande.
reviews.zh: 我係試過同一系列嘅化妝棉之後先買呢啲面膜嘅。包裝超抵用（30 片），而且入面嘅活性成分「Madecassocide」真係好寶貴！如果你嘅泛紅好難舒緩，或者好似我咁有荷爾蒙痘，佢真係好神奇，我推薦。

reviews.text:
estoy muy emocionada de probar estas mascarillas. 
me agrada que es para toda la cara por lo que puedo darme mi tiempo para consentir mi piel. 
venía bien empaquetado. viene con sus pinzas y sellado.
reviews.zh:
我好興奮可以試吓呢啲面膜。
我好喜歡佢係全臉用嘅，咁樣我就可以慢慢花時間寵愛我嘅皮膚。
包裝好好，附有夾子，而且有封口。

reviews.text: i was so excited to try these and i thought they were going to be sensitive skin friendly since it literally says it in the description, but they’re NOT. the fragrance is super strong and i can’t use them without breaking out… my skin is not even THAT sensitive
reviews.zh: 我好期待試呢啲，本來以為對敏感皮膚溫和，因為產品說明寫得明明白白，但係佢哋並唔係。香味超級濃，我用咗就會爆痘……我嘅皮膚都唔係咁敏感喎。

reviews.text: I tried the potato line of this brand's toner pad and really liked it, so I bought a daily mask to try because the material might be the same. Overall, the smell and material are a bit different, but it feels very comfortable when applied to the face. It feels very moist and not greasy. I like the material of the mask, it's like cotton(?) very soft and comfortable. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Will definitely buy it again.
reviews.zh: 我試過呢個品牌嘅 potato 系列化妝棉，好鍾意，所以買咗一片 daily mask 嚟試，因為材料可能一樣。整體嚟講，香味同材料有少少唔同，但敷落面好舒服。感覺好潤，唔油膩。我好鍾意面膜嘅材料，好似棉（？）咁，好軟、好舒服。佢唔會刺激我嘅敏感皮膚。一定會再買。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
